text:
omar: Thanks for the infra segment today. Dropping a thread for the APAC + autoscale Qs that came up. Will collect answers and follow-ups.

devin: two quick things from eng teams: 1) will APAC have access to spot/preemptible instances? 2) how do burst credits work across accounts?

priya: spot in APAC is planned but capacity is vendor-dependent. default pool will be on-demand H100s; we'll offer a spot pool (mixed L40/H100) as a lower-cost opt-in.

ash: curious about burst credits too 1 : can teams save credits in one region and consume in another during cross-region bursts?

priya: short: credits are account-scoped not region-scoped, but there are caps to prevent racing costs. we have a simple token-bucket model: credits accrue up to a cap and are consumed when regionalBurst routes traffic.

jen: what about cold-start SLOs when a request crosses regions? we saw a 400ms median hit in the demo. teams need clarity to set sticky session defaults.

priya: cold-start SLO: target p95 cold-start < 800ms for identical model/variant when cache cannot be preserved. if cache preserved (same binary & runtime) p95 should stay < 200ms. we'll publish microbenchmarks per model in the perf repo.

devin: will prefix/KV cache TTL be shared? some inference pipelines rely on long-lived KV across sessions.

priya: cache TTLs remain per-region; we recommend enabling cross-region replication for stateful endpoints. note replication has cost and eventual consistency. sample config below:
```
replication:
  enabled: true
  mode: async
  ttl: 72h
```

infra-bot: Runbook + perf tests: https://redwood.s3/runbooks/apac-autoscale-runbook.md ; perf repo: https://redwood.s3/perf/apac-model-curves.csv

omar: ops question: who owns rollback if regionalBurst causes cost anomalies? need on-call pairing and an emergency kill switch.

sara: ops owns immediate kill switch (infra/ops team). Lia will own the canary checklist and SRE will be on-call for the first 72 hours of rollout. we'll add a dashboard alert that auto-triggers a rate-limit if cost spikes > 30% over baseline.

ash: can we get a short doc for product teams about recommended configs (latency vs cost) : simple toggles would be helpful.

priya: yes, creating a "playbooks for product teams" doc. initial draft by Wed EOD. will include recommended confs: low-latency, balanced, cost-optimized.

devin: any ETA on when eu/dedicated reservations open for signups? we need to coordinate a customer announcement.

jen: Sales asked about a firm commit date. current target: reservations open June 15, beta slots limited. i'll confirm with sales tomorrow and update.

omar: action list: 1) Priya -> spot pool tech spec + token-bucket docs (due Tue) 2) Lia/SRE -> canary checklist + alert playbook (due Mon) 3) Jen/Sales -> confirm EU reservation launch date (due Thu) 4) Product -> playbook for config presets (draft Wed). I'll ping owners later.

infra-bot: Canary plan: phased rollout across regions: NA -> EU -> APAC, canary window 48h per region. Canary feature flag: feature.autoscaler.regional_burst.

devin: thanks all. will flag any urgent items in #eng-runtime. :rocket:
